newsitem.title: USA: CBOE delays opening of three stock index options.
newsitem.headline: CBOE delays opening of three stock index options.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE) said Thursday it delayed the opening of trading in Standard & Poor's 100, S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 stock index options.
The exchange said in a statement the delays were due to circuit breaker activity.
June S&P 500 futures rose the opening seven-point trading limit. The Dow industrial average .DJI rose more than 50 points, triggering the New York Stock Exchange's curbs on index arbitrage trades.
